summary: Comprehensive backend testing of GreekGodBerry MVP. Created pytest suite covering health, Discord OAuth URL generation, auth guarding, leaderboard proxy (all types, invalid, masked, cache), store rewards + redemption + idempotency + insufficient balance, stream games (create/join/duplicate/resolve/payout), and admin endpoints (grant/users/role-guard). Authenticated flows via minted HS256 JWT cookie + pymongo user seeding. 28/28 tests passed.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses deprecated FastAPI @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown'); prefer lifespan context manager.

Ledger is not truly atomic — insert_one then update_one on users happen in separate ops without a transaction. Under high concurrency two parallel redeems could both read balance=500, both pass check, and cause negative balance (race condition). Consider MongoDB transactions or an atomic findAndModify with $inc guarded by {points_balance: {$gte: cost}}.

resolve_game payout uses idempotency_key gp_{game_id}_{user} which is good, but if a user has no entry with the winning_option they get nothing — payout logic assumes winners_count == matching entries; if no winners, pool is silently forfeited (no refund logic). Consider documenting or refunding.
store/redeem stock decrement (update_one $inc -1) is separate from ledger insert; not atomic — could oversell under concurrency.
Cookie set with secure=True and samesite='lax' — works for HTTPS preview but blocks local http testing. Fine for prod.
No rate limiting on public endpoints; leaderboard cache TTL=60s partially mitigates.
Discord callback silently swallows ledger insert errors (except Exception: pass) — could hide signup bonus bugs.
Owner elevation only happens on login callback; if OWNER_EMAIL user pre-exists via manual seed with different role, not auto-fixed unless they log in.
test_credentials: Seeded via pymongo directly (discord OAuth-only app). Viewer: test_user_1 (1000 pts). Owner: owner_1 (email=OWNER_EMAIL). JWT minted with backend JWT_SECRET, cookie ggb_session.
seed_data_creation: Test fixture inserts test_user_1 and owner_1 into users collection; cleans up after module.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend fully validated. Frontend not tested. Discord OAuth callback path not exercised (requires real Discord). Race-condition/atomicity concerns in ledger + stock updates flagged as code review comments; functional correctness under single-user flows is confirmed.
